Thanks for contributing to ene! Before opening a PR:

1. Branch from `main`; keep one topic per PR.
2. Link an existing issue (`Fixes #123`). For a new feature, open an issue first so the syntax/API change can be agreed on.
3. Add tests that fail without this PR and pass with it.
4. Run `pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck`.
5. New or changed diagnostics need both `en` and `ko` messages in `packages/core/src/diagnostics.ts`.
6. Syntax changes: update README.md / README.ko.md and, if useful, an example in `packages/core/examples`.
-->
